commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
88' Substitution. Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) has come on for Yusi.
87' Adrian Cordero blows for a foul after Arnau Martinez (Girona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.
85' Michel decides to make a substitution. Viktor Tsygankov will be replaced by Hugo Rincon (Girona).
85' The referee signals a substitution. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) is brought on as a substitute for Axel Witsel.
84' The yellow card is received by Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
84' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a throw-in.
83' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
81' The substitution is prepared. Diego Morcillo (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Denis Suarez.
79' A pass by Abel Ruiz (Girona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
76' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is penalised for a foul. Adrian Cordero had a clear view and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Girona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
75' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
74' Yusi (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
71' A substitution has been made. Vladyslav Vanat is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
71' Michel prepares a substitution. Azzedine Ounahi is replaced by Abel Ruiz (Girona).
68' Denis Suarez (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Adrian Cordero ignores the protests.
63' Substitution. Joel Roca (Girona) on for Bryan Gil.
62' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) prepares to take a corner kick.

62' That's unlucky! Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Great teamplay by Girona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

58' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
56' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) picks up a caution.
55' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Alaves players look gutted.
54' The Alaves players halt their celebrations as referee Adrian Cordero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
53' It's a goal! Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 1:1.
53' Alaves earn a corner.

53' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball. Alaves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' Neat passing move from Alaves in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Eduardo Coudet has made a change at the break. Carlos Vicente has come on in place of Carles Alena (Alaves).
46' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Abderrahmane Rebbach comes on the pitch for Calebe (Alaves).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eduardo Coudet probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mariano Diaz (Alaves). He is replaced by Jon Guridi.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' Carles Alena (Alaves) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
43' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle as Bryan Gil (Girona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Alaves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
39' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Girona earn a free kick.
38' Carles Alena (Alaves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. Girona will take a free kick near the side line.
37' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
34' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

34' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Girona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
32' Bryan Gil (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
32' Toni Martinez (Alaves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
29' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
28' Axel Witsel (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Alaves.
24' Bryan Gil (Girona) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
23' The possession of the ball – 59:41.
20' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
19' Carles Alena (Alaves) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Paulo Gazzaniga.
18' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul after Axel Witsel (Girona) hacks down one of his opponents. Alaves win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

16' 1 - 0 The ball hits the back of the net! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) meets a brilliant cross from Bryan Gil and scores with a cracking header from near the penalty spot in off the right post. Antonio Sivera had no chance of stopping that. The score is 1:0.
15' Mariano Diaz (Alaves) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Girona have a free kick.
14' Adrian Cordero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Daley Blind (Girona) and blew his whistle. Alaves have been awarded a free kick.

12' A neat pass finds Antonio Blanco (Alaves) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga denies him with a good save.

12' Denis Suarez (Alaves) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Paulo Gazzaniga leaps like a salmon to deny him.
11' Corner kick. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is ready to send the ball into the box.

11' Arnau Martinez (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
10' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

7' A neat pass is well received by Bryan Gil (Girona), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
5' Girona get a corner.
5' Bryan Gil (Girona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' A cross from Alex Moreno (Girona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.

3' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Jonny Otto (Alaves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Girona have a free kick from a promising distance.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Alaves will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Adrian Cordero.
